title: SKILL.md Anatomy
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Find the part of a skill folder that answers each of six questions about how a harness uses a skill.

educational.topic: Agent Skills and Connecting a Harness to a Local Model
learningObjectives: The learner will identify the part of a skill that answers each of 6 questions about how a harness uses it, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: A harness with 50 skills installed reads only two fields of each at startup. Estimate what would change if it read every body instead.
commonMisconceptions: The harness reads every file in a skill at startup.
The body of `SKILL.md` is how a skill is chosen.
Reference documents are loaded with the instructions.
A skill's scripts run by themselves.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: Agent Skills and Connecting a Harness to a Local Model
